caseEvidence.title: Interactive Ombak Balinese Gamelan Simulator
caseEvidence.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 generates a fully functional interactive Balinese Gamelan web application with microtonal shimmer tuning, interlocking cycles, and live audio synthesis in Claude Artifacts.

model.name: Claude Opus
model.evidence: Post states 'I asked Claude Opus 5.5 Max: "Surprise me"' and the interface selector visibly displays 'Opus 5.5 Max'.

result.evidence: Screen recording demonstrates an interactive Balinese Gamelan artifact titled 'Ombak Gamelan' featuring playable bronze bars, ombak frequency adjustment, tempo controls, and interactive audio playback.
result.textualResultQuote: I built you a Balinese gamelan. Each key is two bronze bars tuned a few hertz apart, so every note shimmers, and the wave above the keys draws that shimmer live.

tools.name: Claude Artifacts
tools.role: Interactive web runtime rendering HTML, Canvas, and Web Audio API synthesizer components.
tools.evidence: Artifact UI header displays 'Ombak Gamelan - Artifact' with interactive buttons, sliders, and audio playback.

caseEvidence.targetModelRole: Generates the complete application code, acoustic microtuning logic, interlocking musical cycle algorithms, and UI components.
caseEvidence.divisionEvidence: Claude UI indicates code execution and file generation ('Edited a file, created a file, and 33...'), rendered directly in the Claude Artifacts sandbox.
caseEvidence.reason: Authentic demonstration of Claude Opus 5.5 generating a complete interactive audio-visual application within Claude Artifacts.

reproduction.evidence: No repository reproduction run is recorded. Author claims and media review are not reproduction.

analysis.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 generates a fully functional interactive Balinese Gamelan web application with microtonal shimmer tuning, interlocking cycles, and live audio synthesis in Claude Artifacts.
